The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, though it may be closer to 24 cm.

The lasagna piece measures roughly 7 cm by 7 cm, or about 6.5 cm across at a thickness of about 4 cm. That gives a volume of about 170 cm³, and at roughly 1 g/cm³ it weighs around 170 g. A piece this size is probably 150-200 g, so I'll use 170 g. At about 1.6 kcal/g, that is roughly 270 kcal.

The bread is a piece of French or Italian loaf about 8 cm long, which I estimate at 45 g. At about 2.8 kcal/g, that is roughly 125 kcal.

Together that is about 215 g of food and roughly 400 kcal.
